cancellation.heading: Event cancelled
cancellation.intro: {greeting} the organizer has cancelled {eventTitle}. Your ticket is no longer valid.
cancellation.preview: {eventTitle} has been cancelled — here's what happens to your ticket
cancellation.questions: If you have any questions about this cancellation or your refund, contact us through the Abonten app.
cancellation.refund: A refund will be issued to the payment method used for your ticket. This can take a few days to complete — you can check its status anytime from My Tickets.
cancellation.subject: Event cancelled — {eventTitle}

common.contactUsThroughTheApp: If you have any questions, contact us through the Abonten app.
common.followAbonten: Follow Abonten for what's on in {city}

digest.intro: {greeting} here {count, plural, one {is a pick} other {are # picks}} based on what you asked to hear about.
digest.unsubscribe: Don't want these emails? <unsubscribe>Unsubscribe</unsubscribe> or <settings>change your settings</settings>. Tickets, payments and account emails aren't affected.
digest.why: You're getting this because you turned on emails about picks and alerts in your Abonten Hub notification settings. At most one a day.

rewards.intro: {greeting} here's what's new with your Abonten Credit.
rewards.unsubscribe: Don't want these emails? <link>Unsubscribe</link>. You'll still see your credit in the app.
rewards.why: You're getting this because you earned Abonten Credit on your Abonten Hub account. Credit can be spent on Abonten and can't be exchanged for cash.
rewards.introTeam: {greeting} here's what's new with the Abonten Credit of {team}, a team you help run.
rewards.whyTeam: You're getting this because you're an Owner or a Finance member of {team} on Abonten Hub. Credit can be spent on Abonten and can't be exchanged for cash.

ticket.attached: Your ticket is attached to this email as a PDF. You can also open it anytime from My Tickets in Abonten.
ticket.heading: Congratulations! 🎟️
ticket.intro: {greeting} your ticket for {eventTitle} has been successfully purchased.
ticket.keepSafe: Please keep your ticket safe — you'll need it (or the attached PDF) for entry at the venue. If you have any questions, contact us through the Abonten app.
ticket.preview: Your Abonten ticket for {eventTitle} is ready — see details inside
ticket.subject: Your Abonten Ticket Is Ready 🎟️ — {eventTitle}

safety.emergencyNote: Abonten does not contact emergency services. If you think {person} is in danger, call {emergency}.
safety.emergencyNoteNoNumber: Abonten does not contact emergency services. If you think {person} is in danger, call the local emergency number.
safety.footer: You are getting this because {person} added you as a trusted contact on Abonten.

invite.subject: {person} added you as an emergency contact
invite.heading: {person} trusts you
invite.intro: {person} added you as an emergency contact on Abonten. If {person} ever needs help, for example on a night out, you will get a text or an email showing where {person} is. You can accept, or say no.

share.subject: {person} is sharing live location with you
share.heading: {hasTime, select, yes {Follow {person} until {time}} other {Follow {person}}}
share.intro: {hasEvent, select, yes {{person} is sharing live location with you on Abonten while at {event}.} other {{person} is sharing live location with you on Abonten.}} Nothing is wrong: this is so you can see {person} gets home safely.

alert.subject: SOS from {person}
alert.heading: {person} may need your help
alert.intro: {hasEvent, select, yes {{person} pressed the help button on Abonten at {event}.} other {{person} pressed the help button on Abonten.}} See where {person} is, and answer so {person} knows you saw it.

checkInMissed.subject: {person} has not checked in
checkInMissed.heading: {person} has not checked in
checkInMissed.intro: {person} planned to check in on Abonten by {time} and has not. See the last known location, and answer so {person} knows you saw it.

safe.subject: {person} is safe
safe.heading: {person} is safe
safe.intro: {person} has ended the alert on Abonten. Thank you for being there.

falseAlarm.subject: The alert from {person} was a mistake
falseAlarm.heading: {person} is OK
falseAlarm.intro: The alert from {person} on Abonten was sent by mistake. Nothing is wrong.

reschedule.subject: {eventTitle} has moved to {newWhen}
reschedule.preview: {eventTitle} is now on {newWhen}. Your ticket is still valid.
reschedule.heading: Your event has moved
reschedule.intro: {greeting} the organizer has moved {eventTitle} to a new date. Your ticket is valid for the new date: you don't need to do anything to keep it.
reschedule.choice: Can't make the new date? Open your ticket and choose Get a refund before {refundUntil}: paid tickets get the ticket price and the service fee back.
reschedule.questions: Questions about the event? Message the organizer from the event page in the Abonten app.
reschedule.previewVenue: {eventTitle} is now at {venue}. Your ticket is still valid.
reschedule.previewPostponed: {eventTitle} is postponed. A new date is to come.
reschedule.headingVenue: Your event has a new venue
reschedule.introDateVenue: {greeting} the organizer has moved {eventTitle} to a new date and a new venue. Your ticket is valid for both: you don't need to do anything to keep it.
reschedule.introOneDate: {greeting} the organizer has moved the date of {eventTitle} you hold a ticket for. Your ticket is valid for the new date: you don't need to do anything to keep it.
reschedule.introVenue: {greeting} the organizer has moved {eventTitle} to a new venue. Your ticket is valid there: you don't need to do anything to keep it.
reschedule.introPostponed: {greeting} the organizer has postponed {eventTitle}. A new date is to come, and we'll tell you as soon as it is set. Your ticket stays valid for it.
reschedule.choiceVenue: Can't get there? Open your ticket and choose Get a refund before {refundUntil}: paid tickets get the ticket price and the service fee back.
reschedule.choicePostponed: Rather have your money back? Open your ticket and choose Get a refund at any time until the new date is set: paid tickets get the ticket price and the service fee back.
